mapper.select: SELECT ss.safe_id AS safeId , ss.item_id AS itemId , ss.item_type AS itemType , ss.item_unit AS itemUnit , ss.daily_capa AS dailyCapa , ss.daily_req_qty AS dailyReqQty , ss.target_days AS targetDays , ss.total_safe_qty AS totalSafeQty , ss.use_yn AS useYn , ss.remark AS remark , COALESCE(p.prd_name, m.mat_name) AS itemName , COALESCE(p.prd_code, m.mat_code) AS itemCode FROM SAFE_STOCK ss LEFT JOIN MATERIAL m ON ss.item_type = 'MAT' AND ss.item_id = m.mat_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON ss.item_type = 'PRD' AND ss.item_id = p.prd_id

SELECT prd_id as itemId , prd_code as itemCode , prd_name as itemName , 'PRD' as itemType , prd_unit as itemUnit FROM PRODUCT WHERE use_Yn = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT mat_id as itemId , mat_code as itemCode , mat_name as itemName , mat_type as itemType , mat_unit as itemUnit FROM MATERIAL WHERE use_Yn = 'Y'
